use_lie_tangent_context: use the LieGroupContext to get or set the thread-local use_lie_tangent flag for Lie group operations
enable_lie_tangent_context_manager: enable Lie tangent mode within a context block using the enable_lie_tangent context manager
disable_lie_tangent_context_manager: disable Lie tangent mode within a context block using the no_lie_tangent context manager
create_lie_group_tensor: create a LieGroupTensor subclass of torch.Tensor wrapping a LieGroup instance for manifold-aware updates
review_lie_group_tensor_add: review the LieGroupTensor add_ method to understand how it projects gradients and retracts on the manifold
